title: pallenis spinosa var. subacaulis
intro: Pallenis spinosa var. subacaulis, commonly known as the Spiny Centaury, is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Pallenis spinosa var. subacaulis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
